scope: Unix native POSIX sh program subset (commands, lists, control flow, functions, aliases) and cross-platform explicit reference-runner boundary

supported.limitations: The versioned word IR retains single, double, escaped, and unquoted fragments; it does not emulate dialect-specific option state.
Each stage is a simple command; typed data pipes use data mode.

forms: for f in *; do echo "$f"; done > list.txt
supported.limitations: Unix native executor: here-documents remain multiline source constructs and descriptor duplication is limited to standard descriptors; Windows retains the C0 redirect graph.
The background marker must terminate the command list.

Unquoted LF separates command lists; leading, blank, and trailing LF are ignored. LF after |, &&, or || continues the operator, and backslash-LF is removed. Quoted LF stays literal. CR outside quotes is whitespace; backslash-CRLF retains an escaped CR and separates at LF. Explicit trailing connectors remain recoverable syntax errors. A # that begins a word starts a comment to the end of the line.
Only NAME=value assignments are accepted; shell export flags and bare-name export are unsupported.

Unix native executor: unquoted parameter and command expansions are field-split on IFS as in sh and Bash; command substitution has a 16 KiB `$(...)` source budget and a 1 MiB output budget; glob no-match behavior is literal and process substitution is an explicit island.

forms: if test -f x; then echo yes; elif true; then :; else echo no; fi
for f in *.md; do echo "$f"; done
case $x in a|b) echo ab;; *) echo other;; esac
supported.limitations: POSIX sh semantics in the session process. Output redirections on a compound command open each target once and stream every inner command to it; targets must be files or devices. Compound commands used as pipeline stages or with input redirections, subshells, [[, ((, select, and read loops run in the /bin/sh island at the interactive prompt.
Functions persist for the session and nest at most 100 calls deep; input redirections on a call and functions as later pipeline stages need the /bin/sh island.
POSIX alias substitution at command position, recursion-safe and bounded to 64 substitutions per line; aliases are not visible inside /bin/sh islands.
The bounded runner starts a clean Bash or Zsh interpreter and does not import profile files.
Uses `bash --noprofile --norc` with bounded capture and cancellation.
Uses `zsh -f` with bounded capture and cancellation.
Dispatch is available through `quirl run`; directly executable files remain selected by the operating system.

deferred.reason: Both forms require multiline or file-descriptor lifecycle semantics; use an explicit dialect island for exact behavior.
